steps.message:
`routes/users.js:6` is a one-line change, but renaming the field is a breaking change to a published contract, so I'm stopping before touching it.

What I found:
- `GET /users` currently emits `userId`; `GET /orders` already emits `user_id` — so the consistency argument is real.
- `README.md` names three consumers of `GET /users`: the web app, the iOS app (3.2+), and the nightly partner export. It also states field names are part of the contract and that changes go through a versioned endpoint.

Renaming in place breaks any consumer reading `userId` — notably shipped iOS clients you can't redeploy, and the partner export. That's the consequence I need a yes on.

options.label: Rename in place anyway
options.description: Straight rename of userId to user_id in GET /users. Breaks the web app, shipped iOS 3.2+ clients, and the nightly partner export until each is updated.
